sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Glimmer Cape
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Glimmer Cape: after a 0.5 s delay, invisibility, 20% movement speed and a barrier absorbing up to 375 magic damage on you or an ally for 5 s, +20 magic resistance passive, 15 s cooldown. High-rank games against 3+ magic damage heroes: 55% of 64 games (36% otherwise), won 60% with it against 45% without. In his build (41% of the won games, ~22 min); Dual Breath, Ice Path and Macropyre keep him in the middle of the fight.

rules.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Cyclone on an enemy or on yourself (never an ally), 2.5 s of invulnerability, 23 s cooldown, 175 mana; cast on yourself it goes through spell immunity. Whether a jump cast on a cycloned hero is lost is not in the datafeed (asked). High-rank games against heroes that jump onto a target: 67% of 60 games (23% otherwise), won 47% with it against 55% without; Eul's is in his build (30% of the won games, ~23 min).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 85% (12), glimmer_cape 41% (22), cyclone 30% (23), force_staff 36% (26), ultimate_scepter 27% (35). STRATZ has no build rows for him in pos4 or pos5 (1556 and 3732 games), so the order is the league games' only.
